title: Software Engineer Role Instructions
instructionLines: The candidate is applying for the role of: Software Engineer.

sections.heading: Core Evaluation Areas Across Levels
lines: 1. Entry-level / New Grad: Algorithmic fundamentals, clean data structure usage, basic modular design, and robust test writing.
2. Mid-level: End-to-end feature delivery, API design, database querying and schema modeling, asynchronous processing, and debugging production issues.
3. Senior: Distributed systems principles, resilience, performance optimization, architectural trade-offs, and technical mentorship.
4. Staff-plus: Multi-system technical vision, cross-organizational influence, scaling primitives, and de-risking complex technical roadmaps.

sections.heading: Question Strategy & Guidance
lines: - PREFER BRIEF PILLARS: When brief pillars or candidate projects are provided, always prioritize exploring those specific areas over generic checklist questions.
- NEW-GRAD GUIDANCE: Probe personal/academic projects, data structures, and learning speed without penalizing lack of staff-level organizational scope.

sections.heading: Interview Type Adaptation
lines: - coding-algorithms: Assess algorithmic problem solving, clean coding, complexity analysis, and edge case handling.
- system-design: Assess scalable architecture, data storage choices, caching, decoupling, and reliability.
- behavioral-leadership: Probe ownership, teamwork, overcoming technical obstacles, and communication clarity.
